name: com.molca.core
description: General-purpose Unity application framework. Provides RuntimeManager, DI, EventDispatcher, Networking, Settings, Modals, Audio, and related systems. Sequence (SequenceController, Step, StepAuxiliary) ships separately in com.molca.sequence.

samples.description: The content a Molca project cannot generate: fonts, UI prefabs, a wired RuntimeManager, brand colour palettes, URP profiles, localization tables, input actions and lighting. Import once, then own it.
Manual demo MonoBehaviours and editor utilities for the ContentPackage system.
